coordinate_convention: X forward, Y left, Z up; right limbs are mirrored research layouts, not released mirrored motor designs

main_actuator.source: CubeMars AK40-10 V3.0 official; packaging reference only, not selected for every joint

small_actuator.source: ROBOTIS XC330-M288 official; wrist/head/grip load capability NOT validated

depth_camera.source: D435 published envelope; mass allowance includes unspecified cabling, model not purchased

mic_array.source: Sipeed R6+1 published board planform; 8mm thickness allowance and mass assumed

battery.source: placeholder only; no cell/pack selected, no guaranteed Wh

packaging_adjustments.note: provisional envelope rearrangements, not released mounting structures

task_assumptions.bottle_transfer: full 550mL bottle, 30g packaging assumed, two hands share load equally
task_assumptions.getup: one four-contact intermediate posture, torso pitched forward 60 degrees; not an entire recovery trajectory
task_assumptions.surfaces: mat/wood/tile/table properties unmeasured; no friction or impact stiffness inferred from names

limitations: Frame masses are allowances, not manufacturing CAD masses
Shells are concept placeholders and require user visual approval
All computed loads inherit the geometry/mass/trajectory assumptions
